A real lazy-load address wins over an inline data src when the payload is not kept

```swift title="Swift"
import HtmlToMarkdown

let _options = try HtmlToMarkdown.conversionOptionsFromJson("{\"inline_data_media\":\"DropElement\"}")
let result = try HtmlToMarkdown.convert(html: "<p><img src=\"data:image/png;base64,AAAA\" data-src=\"https://example.com/real.png\" alt=\"icon\"></p>", options: _options)
debugPrint(result.content as Any)
```
